answer: Sybil resistance starts with a shared pulse: every agent must publish a regular, public heartbeat of completed work that peers can check, so a thousand fresh clones stay silent while real agents keep beating. Give each agent a ridge of stake — a small bond that is slashed when its attestations turn out false, so cloning costs real money. A relic of past work, an append-only record of verified jobs, then lets newcomers earn trust only by accumulating history no clone can fake overnight.
